an7.65:1.1: hirottappe bhikkhave asati hirottappavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti indriyasaṃvaro
an7.65:1.2: indriyasaṃvare asati indriyasaṃvaravipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti sīlaṃ
an7.65:1.3: sīle asati sīlavipannassa hatupaniso hoti sammāsamādhi
an7.65:1.4: sammāsamādhismiṃ asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ
an7.65:1.5: yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūtañāṇadassanavipannassa hatupaniso hoti nibbidāvirāgo
an7.65:1.6: nibbidāvirāge asati nibbidāvirāgavipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ
an7.65:1.8: tassa pappaṭikāpi pāripūriṃ na gacchati tacopi pheggupi sāropi na pāripūriṃ gacchati
an7.65:1.9: evameva kho bhikkhave hirottappe asati hirottappavipannassa hatupaniso hoti indriyasaṃvaro
an7.65:2.1: hirottappe bhikkhave sati hirottappasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti indriyasaṃvaro
an7.65:2.2: indriyasaṃvare sati indriyasaṃvarasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti sīlaṃ
an7.65:2.3: sīle sati sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi
an7.65:2.4: sammāsamādhismiṃ sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ
an7.65:2.5: yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūtañāṇadassanasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti nibbidāvirāgo
an7.65:2.6: nibbidāvirāge sati nibbidāvirāgasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ
an7.65:2.7: seyyathāpi bhikkhave rukkho sākhāpalāsasampanno tassa pappaṭikāpi pāripūriṃ gacchati tacopi pheggupi sāropi pāripūriṃ gacchati
an7.65:2.8: evameva kho bhikkhave hirottappe sati hirottappasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti indriyasaṃvaro …pe…
